statusDefinitions.supported: The named adapter emits and validates this exact Mobile profile in version 0.5.0.
statusDefinitions.mapped-standard: Related source data is admitted only in the coverageDetails alternate representation. It does not implement or claim this Mobile profile.
statusDefinitions.platform-exclusive: The source meaning is admitted only by a platform-exclusive adapter profile and does not implement this Mobile profile.
statusDefinitions.unmodeled: The source element is inventoried by its adapter, but nothing models this Mobile meaning and no output is admitted.
statusDefinitions.deferred: The source has related data, but version 0.5.0 admits no output for this Mobile meaning.
statusDefinitions.intentionally-unsupported: The source has no semantically exact mapping to this Mobile meaning in the closed version 0.5.0 contract.

effectiveCanonicalization.scope: Every Mobile scalar or aggregate effectiveDateTime and effectivePeriod endpoint; Sensor and ECG SampledData timing is excluded.
effectiveCanonicalization.offsetPolicy: Preserve the caller/source numeric UTC offset when it is available; never invent an offset.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Active Energy
measurements.description: Activity-related energy expenditure, excluding basal energy, during an exact effective Period and normalized to UCUM kilocalories.

code.definition: Energy expended through activity, excluding basal energy, during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Apple Exercise Time
measurements.description: Minutes credited to the Apple Watch Exercise ring during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM minutes. The crediting threshold is an Apple-proprietary brisk-activity heuristic, so this is not generic exercise duration and is never mapped to LOINC 55411-3.

code.definition: Time credited by Apple's proprietary Exercise-ring algorithm during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Apple Move Time
measurements.description: Minutes credited to the Apple Watch Move ring in its time-based mode during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM minutes. It is Apple-proprietary ring credit, distinct from both apple-exercise-time and any energy measurement.

code.definition: Time credited by Apple's proprietary time-based Move-ring algorithm during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Apple Stand Hour
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierAppleStandHour: per-hour classification of whether the user stood (or, for wheelchair users, rolled) and moved for at least one minute, as tracked by the Apple Watch Stand ring. Coded result over the exact hour Period.

code.definition: Apple-defined per-hour stand/idle classification from the Activity Stand ring.

resultCodes.definition: The user stood and moved at least one minute during the hour.
The user did not stand and move at least one minute during the hour.

measurements.title: Apple Stand Time
measurements.description: Minutes the user was standing and moving, as credited by the Apple Watch Stand algorithm, during an exact effective Period and normalized to UCUM minutes.

code.definition: Standing time credited by Apple's proprietary Stand algorithm during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Atrial Fibrillation Burden
measurements.description: The estimated percentage of analyzed time showing atrial fibrillation over a multi-day estimation window, normalized to UCUM percent. It is a windowed estimate implemented by the phase-2 aggregate design; the Withings AFib classification scalars remain intentionally unsupported and never join it.

code.definition: The percentage of analyzed heart-rhythm time classified as atrial fibrillation within the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Audiogram Panel
measurements.description: HKAudiogramSample: a hearing test reporting an air conduction threshold per ear at each frequency it measured. The thresholds are parts of one test rather than results that stand alone, so they are components. Every component is optional: a test states the frequencies it measured and no others, and a frequency outside this set is carried by its own component keyed to the frequency rather than forced onto a neighbouring code.

code.display: Pure tone air conduction threshold audiometry panel
code.definition: A hearing test reporting air conduction thresholds across frequencies for each ear.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Basal Body Temperature
measurements.description: A source-neutral basal body temperature recorded at physiologic rest and normalized to UCUM degrees Celsius. It is not the general body-temperature vital sign.

code.definition: Body temperature recorded at physiologic rest for fertility-awareness or cycle-tracking use; it is distinct from a general body-temperature vital sign.

measurements.title: Basal Energy Burned
measurements.description: Resting (basal) energy expenditure accrued during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM kilocalories. It is disjoint from active-energy: the two measurements never overlap in meaning and are summed only by consumers.

code.definition: Resting energy expended by basal metabolism, excluding activity energy, during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Basal Metabolic Rate
measurements.description: The basal metabolic rate as a power, normalized to UCUM kilocalories per day. Only Health Connect evidences it (BasalMetabolicRateRecord), so it stays in the Health Connect adapter guide; it is never relabeled as resting metabolic rate or as an energy total.

code.definition: The subject's basal metabolic rate, expressed as energy per day, reported at the Observation effective instant.

measurements.title: Bladder Incontinence
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierBladderIncontinence: records bladder incontinence as a symptom using HKCategoryValueSeverity (unspecified, notPresent, mild, moderate, severe).

code.definition: Logged severity of bladder incontinence.

measurements.title: Bleeding After Pregnancy
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierBleedingAfterPregnancy: records postpartum bleeding (lochia) using HKCategoryValueVaginalBleeding (unspecified, light, medium, heavy, none). Coded amount result at a point in time.

code.definition: Logged vaginal bleeding amount after pregnancy.

measurements.title: Bleeding During Pregnancy
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierBleedingDuringPregnancy: records bleeding during pregnancy as a symptom using HKCategoryValueVaginalBleeding (verified cases: unspecified, light, medium, heavy, none). Coded amount result at a point in time.

code.definition: Logged vaginal bleeding amount during pregnancy.

measurements.title: Blood Alcohol Content
measurements.description: Blood alcohol content as the mass-percent concentration figure a breathalyzer or user reports, kept as the plain UCUM percent scalar per the decided contract. It is not converted into a laboratory ethanol mass concentration.

code.definition: The blood alcohol concentration expressed as a percent, as reported by the source at the Observation effective instant.

measurements.title: Blood Glucose (Unspecified Specimen)
measurements.description: A glucose mass concentration whose source supplies no specimen evidence, normalized to UCUM mg/dL. The profile REQUIRES the Observation specimen coding to be ABSENT, keeping it disjoint from the four specimen-specific Health Connect glucose profiles that require an exact SNOMED specimen coding.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Blood Pressure
measurements.description: A source-neutral mobile blood-pressure panel that is required to conform to the authoritative FHIR R4 Blood Pressure profile. Systolic and diastolic components are normalized to UCUM millimetres of mercury.

measurements.title: Grove HealthKit Blood Type
measurements.description: ABO and Rh group as a coded Observation. LOINC 882-1 'ABO and Rh group [Type] in Blood' is the exact concept (re-verified ACTIVE, PROPERTY LP6886-8 Type, SCALE_TYP LP7750-5 Nom). Value is a Grove-coded ABO/Rh concept with the HKBloodType token retained as secondary coding per the sleep-stage absorption pattern.

code.display: ABO and Rh group [Type] in Blood

measurements.title: Body Fat Mass
measurements.description: Absolute fat mass computed by a body-composition scale, normalized to UCUM kilograms. Distinct from body-fat percentage; only Withings evidences an absolute fat-mass output, so the profile is provider-scoped.

measurements.title: Body Fat Percentage
measurements.description: A source-neutral body fat measurement expressed as a percentage of total body mass and normalized to UCUM percent. The measurement is method-neutral: sources include bioimpedance scales, connected providers, and manual entry, so no measurement method is asserted.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Body Height
measurements.description: A source-neutral mobile body height that is required to conform to the authoritative FHIR R4 Body Height profile. Values are normalized to UCUM centimetres.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Body Temperature
measurements.description: A source-neutral mobile body temperature that is required to conform to the authoritative FHIR R4 Body Temperature profile. Values are normalized to UCUM degrees Celsius.

measurements.title: Body Water Mass
measurements.description: A source-neutral total body water mass from body-composition analysis, normalized to UCUM kilograms. Despite Withings labeling its measure 'hydration', this is a body-composition mass and is deliberately distinct from dietary water intake.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Body Weight
measurements.description: A source-neutral mobile body weight that is required to conform to the authoritative FHIR R4 Body Weight profile. Values are normalized to UCUM kilograms.

measurements.title: Bone Mass
measurements.description: A source-neutral total bone mass from body-composition analysis, normalized to UCUM kilograms. It is an impedance-estimated mass and is deliberately distinct from DXA bone mineral density, which it never claims.

measurements.title: Cervical Mucus Quality
measurements.description: The observed cervical mucus quality for fertility awareness, with the exact platform value retained as a secondary coding. Health Connect's separate sensation axis rides an optional coded component that HealthKit never emits.

code.definition: The observed cervical mucus quality at the stated instant.

resultCodes.definition: An unusual observation that fits no listed quality.
The quality was recorded without a usable classification.

components.title: Cervical Mucus Sensation
components.definition: The reported cervical mucus sensation accompanying a quality observation.

measurements.title: Contraceptive Use
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierContraceptive: records use of a contraceptive method over the sample interval. Coded result under LOINC 8659-5 Birth control method - Reported (Type/Nom, ACTIVE) with a Grove method value set absorbing HKCategoryValueContraceptive.

resultCodes.definition: A contraceptive whose method is not specified.

measurements.title: Cycling Cadence
measurements.description: A source-neutral instantaneous cycling pedaling cadence sample, normalized to UCUM per minute and displayed as crank revolutions per minute. It is distinct from step cadence, whose counted event is a step rather than a crank revolution.

code.definition: The rate of crank revolutions the subject pedals at the exact Observation effective instant.

measurements.title: Cycling Functional Threshold Power
measurements.description: The estimated maximum cycling power output the subject can sustain for about an hour, as derived by the source, normalized to UCUM watts. It is a derived capacity estimate, distinct from the shared instantaneous power measurement.

code.definition: The source-estimated highest cycling power output the subject can sustain for approximately one hour.

measurements.title: Deep Sleep Duration
measurements.description: Total time classified as deep sleep within one sleep session or civil-day summary, normalized to UCUM minutes over the exact session Period. It is a stage-total aggregate without per-stage intervals, distinct from the interval sleep-stage Observation, and is implemented by the phase-2 aggregate design.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Biotin
measurements.description: Biotin (vitamin B7) consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM micrograms. Grove-coded; the LOINC B7 intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Biotin consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Caffeine
measurements.description: Caffeine consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM milligrams. Grove-coded; the LOINC caffeine-intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Caffeine consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Calcium
measurements.description: Calcium consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM milligrams. Grove-coded; the Pt-timed LOINC calcium intake concepts are substance-amount and the mass concepts are 24-hour rates.

code.definition: Calcium consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Carbohydrates
measurements.description: Total carbohydrate consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM grams.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Chloride
measurements.description: Chloride consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM milligrams. Grove-coded; the LOINC chloride intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Chloride consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Cholesterol
measurements.description: Cholesterol consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM milligrams. Grove-coded; the LOINC cholesterol-intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Cholesterol consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.description: Chromium consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM micrograms. Grove-coded; the LOINC chromium intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Chromium consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

code.definition: Copper consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Energy
measurements.description: Energy consumed from food and drink during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM kilocalories. Distinct from the active/basal energy-expenditure family; intake and expenditure never share a code.

measurements.title: Health Connect Dietary Energy from Fat
measurements.description: Health Connect-only energy from fat consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM kilocalories; HealthKit has no counterpart identifier.

code.definition: Energy-from-fat component of NutritionRecord, distinct from total energy.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Monounsaturated Fat
measurements.description: Monounsaturated fat consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM grams. Grove-coded; only 24-hour LOINC concepts exist.

code.definition: Monounsaturated fat consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Polyunsaturated Fat
measurements.description: Polyunsaturated fat consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM grams. Grove-coded; only 24-hour LOINC concepts exist.

code.definition: Polyunsaturated fat consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Saturated Fat
measurements.description: Saturated fat consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM grams. Grove-coded; both LOINC saturated-fat intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Saturated fat consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Fat
measurements.description: Total fat consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM grams.

measurements.title: Health Connect Dietary Trans Fat
measurements.description: Health Connect-only trans fat mass consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM grams; HealthKit has no trans-fat dietary identifier.

code.definition: Trans fat component of NutritionRecord; the only LOINC trans-fat intake concepts (81034-1 Estimated, 81035-8 Measured) are 24-hour mass-rates and are rejected for the same axis reason as the shared fat rows.

measurements.title: Health Connect Dietary Unsaturated Fat
measurements.description: Health Connect-only total unsaturated fat mass consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM grams; HealthKit has no combined unsaturated-fat identifier and the value cannot be derived when the mono and poly fields are null.

code.definition: Total unsaturated fat component of NutritionRecord.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Fiber
measurements.description: Dietary fiber consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM grams. Grove-coded because the only measured LOINC fiber concept is a 24-hour mass-rate, not a per-event mass.

code.definition: Dietary fiber consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Folate
measurements.description: Total folate (vitamin B9) consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM micrograms. Grove-coded; the LOINC B9 intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Total folate consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Health Connect Dietary Folic Acid
measurements.description: Health Connect-only synthetic folic acid mass consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM micrograms; distinct from total folate.

code.definition: Synthetic folic acid component of NutritionRecord; LOINC has no folic-acid intake concept separate from total folate (NLM search returns only the vitamin B9 folate pair).

code.definition: Niacin consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Pantothenic Acid
measurements.description: Pantothenic acid (vitamin B5) consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM milligrams. Grove-coded; the LOINC B5 intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Pantothenic acid consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.description: Phosphorus consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM milligrams. Grove-coded; the LOINC phosphorus intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Phosphorus consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Potassium
measurements.description: Potassium consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM milligrams. Grove-coded for the same substance-versus-mass property mismatch as sodium.

code.definition: Potassium consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Protein
measurements.description: Protein consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM grams.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Riboflavin
measurements.description: Riboflavin (vitamin B2) consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM milligrams. Grove-coded; the LOINC B2 intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

measurements.description: Selenium consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM micrograms. Grove-coded; the LOINC selenium intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Selenium consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Sodium
measurements.description: Sodium consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM milligrams. Grove-coded because the point-timed LOINC sodium-intake concept is substance-amount, not mass.

code.definition: Sodium consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Sugar
measurements.description: Total sugars consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM grams. Grove-coded because LOINC has no active point-timed sugar-intake mass concept.

code.definition: Total sugars consumed from food and drink during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Thiamin
measurements.description: Thiamin (vitamin B1) consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM milligrams. Grove-coded; the LOINC B1 intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Thiamin consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Dietary Vitamin A
measurements.description: Vitamin A consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM micrograms. Grove-coded; the only LOINC vitamin A intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Vitamin A consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.description: Vitamin B12 consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM micrograms. Grove-coded; the LOINC B12 intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Vitamin B12 consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.description: Vitamin B6 consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM milligrams. Grove-coded; the LOINC B6 intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Vitamin B6 consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.description: Vitamin C consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM milligrams. Grove-coded; the LOINC vitamin C intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Vitamin C consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.description: Vitamin D consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM micrograms. Grove-coded; the LOINC vitamin D intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Vitamin D consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.description: Vitamin E consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM milligrams. Grove-coded; the LOINC vitamin E intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Vitamin E consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.description: Vitamin K consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM micrograms. Grove-coded; the LOINC vitamin K intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Vitamin K consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.description: Zinc consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM milligrams. Grove-coded; the LOINC zinc intake concepts are 24-hour mass-rates.

code.definition: Zinc consumed during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Distance
measurements.description: Distance traveled during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM metres.

sensorkit.reason: The heterogeneous odometer record is retained as an exact raw recording; it does not implement the Mobile distance profile.

measurements.title: Electrodermal Activity
measurements.description: Skin electrical conductance normalized to UCUM microsiemens. Two sources evidence the raw scalar — HealthKit's electrodermal activity samples and the Withings Body Scan feet measurement (meastype 196) — and the sensor body site is preserved as a body-site coding rather than collapsed.

code.definition: The electrical conductance of the skin at the Observation effective instant.

measurements.title: Elevation Gained
measurements.description: Vertical elevation gained during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM metres. Withings intraday elevation series remain in the provider recording document and do not implement this profile.

code.definition: The total vertical distance ascended during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Environmental Audio Exposure
measurements.description: The A-weighted equivalent continuous sound pressure level of environmental sound over an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM decibels sound pressure level per the pinned Grove decibel convention. Only HealthKit evidences this concept.

code.definition: The A-weighted equivalent continuous sound pressure level of environmental sound the user was exposed to during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Environmental Audio Exposure Notification
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierAudioExposureEvent: raised when environmental sound reaches the momentary limit. The environmental audio exposure quantity remains the measurement surface.

code.definition: A device notification that environmental sound reached the momentary exposure limit.

resultCodes.definition: HKCategoryValueEnvironmentalAudioExposureEvent.momentaryLimit: the momentary exposure limit was reached.

measurements.title: Environmental Sound Reduction
measurements.description: The reduction in equivalent continuous sound pressure level provided by noise-reducing headphones over an exact effective Period, expressed in UCUM decibels sound pressure level per the pinned Grove decibel convention. The value is a level difference, not an absolute exposure level.

code.definition: The difference in equivalent continuous sound pressure level attenuated by the user's noise-reducing headphones during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Extracellular Water Mass
measurements.description: Mass of extracellular body water estimated by bioelectrical impedance, normalized to UCUM kilograms. Only Withings evidences the compartmentalized value, so the profile is provider-scoped and is distinct from total body-water mass.

code.definition: The mass of body water outside cells as estimated by bioelectrical impedance analysis.

measurements.title: Flights Climbed
measurements.description: The number of flights of stairs (floors) ascended during an exact effective Period. Health Connect's fractional floors are preserved as a decimal count of the same measurand.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Fluid Intake
measurements.description: Water or fluid consumed during an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM millilitres. Carries HealthKit dietary water and Health Connect hydration under one shared concept; it belongs to the hydration family, not the dietary-nutrient family, hence the id outside the dietary- prefix.

measurements.title: Food Correlation
measurements.description: One eating occasion, whose members are the nutrient Observations recorded for it. The nutrients are independently meaningful and are already modelled one by one, so the occasion groups them rather than restating them as components.

code.definition: One eating occasion grouping the nutrient results recorded for it.

measurements.title: Forced Expiratory Volume in 1 Second
measurements.description: The volume of air forcibly exhaled during the first second of a forced exhalation, captured as a point spirometry result and normalized to UCUM litres. Only HealthKit evidences this concept, so it lands in the HealthKit adapter guide.

measurements.title: Forced Vital Capacity
measurements.description: The volume of air forcibly exhaled after the deepest possible breath, captured as a point spirometry result and normalized to UCUM litres. Only HealthKit evidences this concept, so it lands in the HealthKit adapter guide.

code.display: Forced vital capacity [Volume] Respiratory system by Spirometry

measurements.title: Grove HealthKit GAD-7 Score
measurements.description: HKGAD7Assessment (iOS 18, HKScoredAssessment subclass): score 0-21, answers [HKGAD7Assessment.Answer], risk. Routing recommendation: platform-exclusive score Observation on exact LOINC 70274-6 'Generalized anxiety disorder 7 item (GAD-7) total score [Reported.PHQ]' (re-verified ACTIVE, PROPERTY LP185820-0 Score, SCALE_TYP LP7753-9 Qn). The seven answers are retained as components coded with the LOINC GAD-7 item codes under panel 69737-5 (re-verified), each valued with the standard LOINC answer codes (LA6568-5 'Not at all', LA6569-3 'Several days', LA6570-1 'More than half the days', LA6571-9 'Nearly every day' — all four displays re-verified against LOINC 2.82 via tx.fhir.org) absorbing Answer cases notAtAll, severalDays, moreThanHalfTheDays, nearlyEveryDay; Risk (noneToMinimal, mild, moderate, severe — re-verified) is redundant with the published score bands and is carried only as an Observation.interpretation-style Grove coding, not a value.

code.display: Generalized anxiety disorder 7 item (GAD-7) total score [Reported.PHQ]

measurements.title: Handwashing Session
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierHandwashingEvent: an interval sample (notApplicable value) recorded automatically by Apple Watch Series 4+ or written by apps; the sample duration is the handwashing duration. Emitted as a duration quantity over the exact Period.

code.definition: The duration of one handwashing event during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Headphone Audio Exposure
measurements.description: The A-weighted equivalent continuous sound pressure level delivered through headphones over an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM decibels sound pressure level per the pinned Grove decibel convention. Only HealthKit evidences this concept.

code.definition: The A-weighted equivalent continuous sound pressure level of headphone audio the user was exposed to during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Headphone Audio Exposure Notification
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierHeadphoneAudioExposureEvent: raised when headphone exposure reaches the seven-day limit. The headphone audio exposure quantity remains the measurement surface.

code.definition: A device notification that headphone audio exposure reached the seven-day limit.

resultCodes.definition: HKCategoryValueHeadphoneAudioExposureEvent.sevenDayLimit: the rolling seven-day exposure limit was reached.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Heart Rate
measurements.description: A source-neutral mobile heart rate that is required to conform to the authoritative FHIR R4 Heart Rate profile and adds Grove exchange identity and provenance context. Values are normalized to UCUM beats per minute.

sensorkit.reason: The high-frequency series and per-point confidence are retained as an exact raw recording; it does not implement the Mobile heart-rate profile.

google-health-api.reason: Irregular provider points are retained as an exact raw recording; it does not implement the Mobile heart-rate profile.

oura.reason: Irregular provider points are retained as an exact raw recording; it does not implement the Mobile heart-rate profile.

measurements.title: Heart Rate Recovery (One Minute)
measurements.description: The reduction in heart rate from workout peak to exactly one minute after exercise ends, normalized to UCUM beats per minute. The one-minute protocol is part of the meaning, so the value is not a heart rate and never joins the shared heart-rate measurement.

code.definition: The decrease in heart rate, in beats per minute, from peak exercise to one minute after the end of exercise.

measurements.title: Heart Rate Variability RMSSD
measurements.description: The root mean square of successive differences between NN (R-R) intervals, normalized to UCUM milliseconds. RMSSD is never relabeled as SDNN; the two HRV statistics remain separate measurements.

code.definition: The root mean square of successive differences between adjacent NN intervals at the Observation effective instant.

measurements.title: Heart Rate Variability SDNN
measurements.description: Standard deviation of NN (normal-to-normal R-R) intervals over the source measurement window, normalized to UCUM milliseconds. SDNN is not interchangeable with RMSSD; the two statistics are distinct measurements and never merge.

measurements.title: High Heart Rate Notification
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierHighHeartRateEvent: an Apple Watch notification raised against a user-configurable threshold. This is the notification, not a rhythm finding; the heart-rate quantities remain the measurement surface, and the threshold that raised it is carried as a component so the notification can be interpreted at all.

code.definition: A device notification that heart rate stayed above the wearer's configured threshold while apparently inactive.

resultCodes.definition: The device raised this notification over the stated Period. HealthKit carries no further value for it.

components.title: Notification threshold
components.definition: The wearer-configured heart rate above which the device raises this notification.

measurements.title: Hypertension Notification
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierHypertensionEvent: a proprietary screening notification. Blood pressure remains the measurement surface; this records only that the notification was raised, and never asserts a hypertension diagnosis.

code.definition: A device notification of blood-pressure readings consistent with hypertension.

resultCodes.definition: The device raised this notification over the stated Period. HealthKit carries no further value for it.

measurements.title: Infrequent Menstrual Cycles
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierInfrequentMenstrualCycles: a deviation derived from the wearer's own logged cycle records over the stated Period.

code.definition: Cycles occurring less often than expected, derived from the participant's logged cycle records. Corresponds to SNOMED CT 52073004 (Oligomenorrhea); the concept is cited rather than bound, because this guide carries no SNOMED dependency.

resultCodes.definition: The pattern was detected over the stated Period from the wearer's own logged cycle records.
The pattern was evaluated over the stated Period and not detected.

measurements.title: Inhaler Usage
measurements.description: The number of inhaler puffs taken during an exact effective Period. The count is a device-usage total, not a medication-administration record, and only HealthKit evidences it.

code.definition: The total number of inhaler puffs the user took during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Insulin Delivery
measurements.description: The quantity of insulin delivered during the exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM international units, with a REQUIRED delivery-reason component distinguishing basal from bolus delivery per the decided contract. A sample without the HKMetadataKeyInsulinDeliveryReason metadata fails closed.

code.definition: The amount of insulin delivered during the exact Observation effective Period, qualified by a required basal or bolus delivery reason.

measurements.title: Intermenstrual Bleeding
measurements.description: A logged intermenstrual (spotting) bleeding event; the fixed result states presence.

code.definition: An observed bleeding event between menstrual periods.

measurements.title: Intracellular Water Mass
measurements.description: Mass of intracellular body water estimated by bioelectrical impedance, normalized to UCUM kilograms. Only Withings evidences the compartmentalized value, so the profile is provider-scoped and is distinct from total body-water mass.

code.definition: The mass of body water inside cells as estimated by bioelectrical impedance analysis.

measurements.title: Irregular Heart Rhythm Notification
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierIrregularHeartRhythmEvent: an FDA-cleared screening notification from a proprietary algorithm. It is emitted as a notification and never as a rhythm finding: the electrocardiogram and the atrial-fibrillation burden percentage remain the rhythm evidence, and this Observation links to them through derivedFrom.

code.definition: A device notification of a heart rhythm irregularity consistent with atrial fibrillation.

resultCodes.definition: The device raised this notification over the stated Period. HealthKit carries no further value for it.

measurements.title: Irregular Menstrual Cycles
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierIrregularMenstrualCycles: a deviation derived from the wearer's own logged cycle records over the stated Period. This is a finding, not a device notification: nothing was sensed, and the pattern is computed from data the participant entered.

code.definition: Cycle lengths outside the expected range, derived from the participant's logged cycle records. Corresponds to SNOMED CT 80182007 (Irregular periods); the concept is cited rather than bound, because this guide carries no SNOMED dependency.

resultCodes.definition: The pattern was detected over the stated Period from the wearer's own logged cycle records.
The pattern was evaluated over the stated Period and not detected.

measurements.title: Lactation Status
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierLactation: an interval flag (notApplicable value) asserting lactation over the sample period. Emitted as a coded Observation under LOINC 63895-7 Breastfeeding status (Find/Nom, ACTIVE) with the fixed Grove result lactating over the exact effective Period.

resultCodes.definition: The person was lactating during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Lean Body Mass
measurements.description: A source-neutral lean body mass normalized to UCUM kilograms. Consumer bioimpedance sources report fat-free mass under this label; the lean-body-mass versus fat-free-mass distinction (essential fat) is not recoverable from any source, so Withings fat-free mass joins this measurement with that caveat rather than forming a separate concept.

measurements.title: Light Sleep Duration
measurements.description: Total time classified as light sleep within one sleep session or civil-day summary, normalized to UCUM minutes over the exact session Period. It is a stage-total aggregate without per-stage intervals and is implemented by the phase-2 aggregate design.

measurements.title: Low Cardio Fitness Notification
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierLowCardioFitnessEvent: raised when the VO2 max estimate falls below a threshold. The threshold is carried as a component.

code.definition: A device notification that estimated cardio fitness fell below the configured threshold.

resultCodes.definition: HKCategoryValueLowCardioFitnessEvent.lowFitness: the cardio fitness estimate is below the threshold.

components.title: Notification threshold
components.definition: The cardio fitness estimate below which the device raises this notification.

measurements.title: Low Heart Rate Notification
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierLowHeartRateEvent: an Apple Watch notification raised against a user-configurable threshold. The threshold is carried as a component; the heart-rate quantities remain the measurement surface.

code.definition: A device notification that heart rate stayed below the wearer's configured threshold while apparently inactive.

resultCodes.definition: The device raised this notification over the stated Period. HealthKit carries no further value for it.

components.title: Notification threshold
components.definition: The wearer-configured heart rate below which the device raises this notification.

measurements.title: Menstruation Flow
measurements.description: The observed menstrual flow classification, with the exact platform value retained as a secondary coding. The HealthKit iOS 18 vaginal-bleeding replacement uses the identical case set. HealthKit's mandatory cycle-start metadata is carried as an optional coded component so no source information is dropped.

code.definition: The observed menstrual flow classification at the stated instant.

resultCodes.definition: Flow was recorded without an amount.
No flow was observed; recorded only by HealthKit.

components.definition: Whether the flow observation marks the first day of a menstrual cycle, as the source states it.

resultCodes.definition: The observation marks the first day of a menstrual cycle.
The observation does not mark the first day of a menstrual cycle.

components.title: Menstrual Cycle Start

measurements.title: Menstruation Period
measurements.description: One user-recorded menstruation period interval. Health Connect records the interval directly; HealthKit derives intervals from flow samples and therefore never emits this profile.

code.definition: One recorded menstruation period over the exact Observation effective Period.

resultCodes.definition: A menstruation period spanned the effective Period.

measurements.title: Mindfulness Session
measurements.description: The duration of one mindfulness session over its exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM minutes. Source session subtype (meditation, breathing, etc.) is adapter context and does not alter the normalized duration.

code.definition: The duration of a single mindfulness session covering the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Muscle Mass
measurements.description: A providers-exclusive whole-body muscle mass calculated by bioimpedance analysis, normalized to UCUM kilograms. It is distinct from lean body mass (which additionally includes bone, water, and organ mass) and is not folded into that shared measurement.

measurements.title: Number of Alcoholic Beverages
measurements.description: The count of standard alcoholic drinks consumed during the exact effective Period, using the annotated dimensionless UCUM unit {drinks}. Counting semantics follow the source's standard-drink definition and are not converted to ethanol mass.

code.definition: The number of standard alcoholic drinks attributed to the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Number of Times Fallen
measurements.description: The number of falls recorded during an exact effective Period, normalized to the UCUM annotation {falls}. This is a device or user-recorded interval count, not a clinical falls-history assessment.

code.definition: The total number of falls attributed to the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Ovulation Test Result
measurements.description: The result of a home ovulation test, with the exact platform value retained as a secondary coding. HealthKit's estrogen-surge case widens to high-fertility with the source coding preserving the distinction.

code.definition: The classified result of a home ovulation test.

resultCodes.definition: An elevated fertility indicator short of a confirmed LH surge.
The test could not be interpreted.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Oxygen Saturation
measurements.description: A source-neutral mobile oxygen saturation that is required to conform to the authoritative FHIR R4 Oxygen Saturation profile. Values are normalized to UCUM percent.

measurements.title: Oxygen Saturation Daily Average
measurements.description: The mean oxygen saturation over a civil-date effective Period, normalized to UCUM percent. It is distinct from the point-in-time shared oxygen-saturation measurement and is implemented by the phase-2 aggregate design.

measurements.title: Peak Expiratory Flow Rate
measurements.description: The maximum expiratory gas flow generated during a forceful exhalation, captured as a point result and normalized to UCUM litres per minute. The method-agnostic LOINC concept is chosen because HealthKit does not constrain the measuring device.

code.display: Maximum expiratory gas flow Respiratory system airway

measurements.title: Peripheral Perfusion Index
measurements.description: The pulse-oximetry perfusion index — the ratio of pulsatile to non-pulsatile blood flow at the sensor site — normalized to UCUM percent. Only HealthKit evidences it, so it stays in the HealthKit adapter guide.

code.display: Perfusion index Tissue by Pulse oximetry

measurements.title: Persistent Intermenstrual Bleeding
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierPersistentIntermenstrualBleeding: a deviation derived from the wearer's own logged cycle records over the stated Period. No verified SNOMED concept is bound; the adapter code system carries the meaning rather than approximating a clinical concept.

code.definition: Bleeding between periods persisting across cycles, derived from logged cycle records.

resultCodes.definition: The pattern was detected over the stated Period from the wearer's own logged cycle records.
The pattern was evaluated over the stated Period and not detected.

measurements.title: Grove HealthKit PHQ-9 Score
measurements.description: HKPHQ9Assessment (iOS 18, HKScoredAssessment subclass): score 0-27, answers [HKPHQ9Assessment.Answer] including preferNotToAnswer, risk. Routing recommendation: platform-exclusive score Observation on exact LOINC 44261-6 'Patient Health Questionnaire 9 item (PHQ-9) total score [Reported]' (re-verified ACTIVE, Score, Qn); item answers retained as components under panel 44249-1 'PHQ-9 quick depression assessment panel [Reported.PHQ]' (re-verified) with the standard LA answer codes; preferNotToAnswer maps to a component with dataAbsentReason asked-declined, which is the semantically exact FHIR mechanism; Risk (noneToMinimal, mild, moderate, moderatelySevere, severe — re-verified) carried as interpretation-style Grove coding only.

code.display: Patient Health Questionnaire 9 item (PHQ-9) total score [Reported]

measurements.title: Physical Effort
measurements.description: The estimated intensity of physical exertion over an exact effective Period, normalized to UCUM kilocalories per kilogram per hour as sourced from Apple's physicalEffort samples. It is an energy-normalized intensity rate, deliberately not converted to the oxygen-based UCUM [MET].

code.definition: Estimated exertion intensity, in energy per body mass per time, over the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Power
measurements.description: A source-neutral instantaneous mechanical power output sample recorded during activity, normalized to UCUM watts. The activity binding (running, cycling) is carried by source context and workout session linkage, not by the code. It is distinct from the cycling functional threshold power estimate, which is a derived capacity value rather than an instantaneous sample.

code.definition: The mechanical power the subject produces at the exact Observation effective instant, recorded during activity.

measurements.title: Pregnancy Status
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierPregnancy: an interval flag (notApplicable value) asserting pregnancy over the sample period. Emitted as a coded Observation under LOINC 82810-3 Pregnancy status (Find/Nom, ACTIVE) with the fixed Grove result pregnant over the exact effective Period.

resultCodes.definition: The person was pregnant during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Pregnancy Test Result
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierPregnancyTestResult: the result of a home urine hCG pregnancy test. Apple documentation states these tests check for hCG in a urine sample, so LOINC 2106-3 (Choriogonadotropin [Presence] in Urine, PrThr/Ord, ACTIVE) is semantically exact.

resultCodes.definition: The pregnancy test result could not be determined.

measurements.title: Progesterone Test Result
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierProgesteroneTestResult: the result of a home urine test for pregnanediol-3-glucuronide (PdG) confirming ovulation, per Apple documentation. Qualitative positive/negative/indeterminate result.

code.definition: Qualitative result of a home urine pregnanediol-3-glucuronide test.

resultCodes.definition: The PdG test result could not be determined.

measurements.title: Prolonged Menstrual Periods
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierProlongedMenstrualPeriods: a deviation derived from the wearer's own logged cycle records over the stated Period. No verified SNOMED concept is bound; the adapter code system carries the meaning rather than approximating a clinical concept.

code.definition: Periods lasting longer than expected, derived from logged cycle records.

resultCodes.definition: The pattern was detected over the stated Period from the wearer's own logged cycle records.
The pattern was evaluated over the stated Period and not detected.

measurements.title: REM Sleep Duration
measurements.description: Total time classified as REM sleep within one sleep session or civil-day summary, normalized to UCUM minutes over the exact session Period. It is a stage-total aggregate without per-stage intervals and is implemented by the phase-2 aggregate design.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Respiratory Rate
measurements.description: A source-neutral mobile respiratory rate that is required to conform to the authoritative FHIR R4 Respiratory Rate profile. Values are normalized to breaths per minute.

measurements.title: Respiratory Rate Average
measurements.description: The mean respiratory rate over a windowed effective Period, normalized to UCUM breaths per minute; current source windows are a civil date (Google) and a sleep session (Oura, Withings), and the window is carried entirely by the effectivePeriod. It is distinct from the point-in-time shared respiratory-rate measurement and is implemented by the phase-2 aggregate design.

measurements.title: Resting Heart Rate
measurements.description: A windowed estimate of the heart rate while at rest, normalized to UCUM beats per minute over the exact estimation window. It is semantically distinct from the shared point heart-rate measurement and is implemented by the phase-2 aggregate design. LOINC 40443-4 is deliberately not used: it denotes a heart rate measured at rest, which R4 classifies as a vital sign, whereas this result is a derived daily estimate that must not be surfaced as a measured vital sign.

code.definition: The estimated heart rate at rest across the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Running Ground Contact Time
measurements.description: The time the foot is in contact with the ground per running stride, normalized to UCUM milliseconds. A per-sample running dynamics metric recorded during workouts.

code.definition: The ground contact time of one running stride at the sample instant.

measurements.title: Running Stride Length
measurements.description: The distance covered by one running stride, normalized to UCUM metres. A per-sample running dynamics metric recorded during workouts.

code.definition: The distance covered by one running stride at the sample instant.

measurements.title: Running Vertical Oscillation
measurements.description: The vertical bounce of the torso per running stride, normalized to UCUM centimetres. A per-sample running dynamics metric recorded during workouts.

code.definition: The vertical oscillation of the torso during running at the sample instant.

measurements.title: Sexual Activity
measurements.description: A logged sexual-activity event whose result states whether protection was used, with the exact platform value retained where a platform enum exists.

code.definition: A logged sexual-activity event with its protection-used classification.

measurements.title: Six-Minute Walk Test Distance
measurements.description: The distance walked (or estimated walkable) in six minutes, using LOINC Six minute walk test and normalized to UCUM metres. Apple's samples are predominantly rolling-window mobility estimates rather than administered tests, so the phase-2 aggregate design owns the emission contract.

measurements.title: Skin Temperature
measurements.description: A source-neutral skin (body surface) temperature normalized to UCUM degrees Celsius and carrying a body-site coding (wrist for Apple sleeping wrist temperature; the Health Connect measurement location when present). It is deliberately distinct from the core body-temperature vital sign and is never relabeled as it.

measurements.title: Sleep Apnea Notification
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierSleepApneaEvent: a proprietary screening notification. The sleeping breathing disturbances quantity remains the measurement surface; this records that the notification was raised.

code.definition: A device notification of breathing disturbances consistent with sleep apnea.

resultCodes.definition: The device raised this notification over the stated Period. HealthKit carries no further value for it.

measurements.title: Awake Duration During Sleep
measurements.description: Total time awake within one sleep session or civil-day sleep summary, normalized to UCUM minutes over the exact session Period. It is a stage-total aggregate without per-stage intervals and is implemented by the phase-2 aggregate design.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Sleep Duration
measurements.description: Total duration classified as sleep during an exact effective Period, using LOINC Sleep duration and normalized to UCUM hours. This summary does not encode sleep stages.

measurements.title: Sleep Heart Rate
measurements.description: A heart-rate statistic computed over one sleep session (Oura reports the session minimum, Withings the session mean), normalized to UCUM beats per minute over the exact session Period. The statistic is carried by the aggregate design's fixed method coding, never collapsed into the shared point heart-rate measurement.

code.definition: A heart-rate statistic aggregated over the exact sleep-session effective Period.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Sleep Stage
measurements.description: A source-neutral sleep-stage classification for one exact interval. A session summary links its ordered, non-overlapping stage Observations through hasMember.

code.definition: The classification assigned to an exact interval within a sleep session.

measurements.title: Sleeping Breathing Disturbances
measurements.description: A nightly windowed aggregate of accelerometry-detected breathing disturbances during sleep, expressed as disturbance events per hour of sleep over the night's effective Period. It is a proprietary screening metric and is deliberately not coded as a clinical respiratory disturbance or apnea-hypopnea index.

code.definition: The number of accelerometer-detected breathing disturbance events per hour of sleep during the exact nightly Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Sleeping Heart Rate Average
measurements.description: The average heart rate across one sleep session, normalized to UCUM beats per minute. It is a session-windowed average, distinct from both the shared point heart-rate measurement and the daily resting-heart-rate estimate, and is implemented by the phase-2 aggregate design.

code.definition: The mean heart rate across the exact sleep-session Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Speed
measurements.description: A source-neutral instantaneous speed sample recorded during activity, normalized to UCUM metres per second. The activity binding (running, cycling, skiing, paddling, rowing) is carried by source context and workout session linkage, not by the code, mirroring the shipped generic distance measurement. It is distinct from walking speed and the stair speeds, whose gait-health bindings are part of those concepts.

code.definition: The subject's instantaneous speed of travel at the exact Observation effective instant, recorded during activity.

measurements.title: Stair Ascent Speed
measurements.description: The vertical speed at which the subject climbs stairs, recorded passively by HealthKit and normalized to UCUM metres per second. It is distinct from the shared exercise speed measurement because the stair-climbing binding is part of the concept.

measurements.title: Stair Descent Speed
measurements.description: The vertical speed at which the subject descends stairs, recorded passively by HealthKit and normalized to UCUM metres per second. It is distinct from the shared exercise speed measurement because the stair-descent binding is part of the concept.

measurements.title: State of Mind
measurements.description: HKStateOfMind: a self-reported reflection on how the participant felt. Valence is the one numeric axis and carries the Observation value, reported on HealthKit's closed −1.0 to 1.0 scale; the reflection's kind, its classification, and its labels and associations are coded components. Every axis is the participant's own report, not a measurement.

code.definition: A self-reported reflection on felt experience, valenced from unpleasant to pleasant.

components.title: Reflection kind
components.definition: HKStateOfMind.Kind: whether the reflection describes a momentary feeling or a longer period.

resultCodes.definition: HKStateOfMind.Kind.momentaryEmotion: how the participant felt at the moment of reflection.
HKStateOfMind.Kind.dailyMood: how the participant felt over the day.

components.title: Valence classification
components.definition: HKStateOfMind.ValenceClassification: the coarse band the reported valence falls in.

components.title: Label
components.definition: HKStateOfMind.Label: a word the participant chose for the feeling. Repeats once per chosen label.

components.title: Association
components.definition: HKStateOfMind.Association: a life area the participant attributed the feeling to. Repeats once per association.

measurements.title: Step Cadence
measurements.description: The instantaneous rate of steps taken, normalized to UCUM steps per minute using the allowlisted {steps} annotation. It is distinct from cycling cadence (crank revolutions) and from the shared step-count total (a Period sum, not a rate).

code.definition: The rate of steps the subject takes at the exact Observation effective instant.

measurements.title: Grove Mobile Step Count
measurements.description: The number of steps recorded during an exact effective Period.

code.definition: The total number of steps attributed to the exact Observation effective Period.

sensorkit.reason: The composite pedometer record is retained as an exact raw recording; it does not implement the Mobile step-count profile.

measurements.title: Swimming Stroke Count
measurements.description: The number of swimming strokes recorded during an exact effective Period, normalized to the UCUM annotation {strokes}.

code.definition: The total number of swimming strokes attributed to the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Toothbrushing Session

code.definition: The sum of basal and activity energy expended during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Underwater Depth
measurements.description: A HealthKit-exclusive measurement of the wearer's depth below the water surface during a submersion, normalized to UCUM metres. It is an environmental position reading exclusive to Apple Watch Ultra submersions.

code.definition: The depth of the wearer below the water surface during a submersion, as sampled by the device.

measurements.title: UV Exposure
measurements.description: The dimensionless Global Solar UV Index the user was exposed to during an exact effective Period. Only HealthKit evidences this concept, and values are typically app-contributed rather than sensor-derived.

code.definition: The Global Solar UV Index value the user was exposed to during the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Vaginal Dryness
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierVaginalDryness: records vaginal dryness as a symptom using HKCategoryValueSeverity (verified cases: unspecified, notPresent, mild, moderate, severe).

code.definition: Logged severity of vaginal dryness.

measurements.title: VO2 Max
measurements.description: The maximal oxygen consumption per body mass, normalized to UCUM millilitres per kilogram per minute. Sources deliver estimated or test-derived maxima; the estimation method is adapter context and does not alter the normalized value.

code.definition: The maximal oxygen consumption per kilogram of body mass, whether measured or estimated, reported at the Observation effective instant.

measurements.title: Waist Circumference
measurements.description: A HealthKit-exclusive waist circumference normalized to UCUM centimetres. The LOINC code asserts the umbilicus site and tape-measure method that HealthKit does not itself state; this is the established consumer-health interoperability mapping and the caveat is documented rather than inventing a Grove code.

code.display: Waist Circumference at umbilicus by Tape measure

measurements.title: Walking Asymmetry
measurements.description: The percentage of walking time in which the step timing of one foot differs from the other, recorded passively by HealthKit and normalized to UCUM percent. Higher values indicate a less even gait.

measurements.title: Walking Double Support
measurements.description: The percentage of walking time in which both feet are in contact with the ground, recorded passively by HealthKit and normalized to UCUM percent.

measurements.title: Walking Heart Rate Average
measurements.description: The average heart rate during walking activity over a daily window, normalized to UCUM beats per minute. HealthKit-only evidence today; the phase-2 aggregate design implements the windowing.

code.definition: The mean heart rate during periods classified as walking within the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Walking Speed
measurements.description: The instantaneous-to-short-bout walking speed HealthKit records passively as a mobility metric, normalized to UCUM metres per second. It is distinct from the shared exercise speed measurement: the walking binding is part of the concept, and it is a gait-health signal rather than a workout series.

code.definition: The speed at which the subject walks, sampled by the source during ordinary walking bouts.

measurements.title: Walking Steadiness
measurements.description: Apple's windowed walking-steadiness score, a rolling multi-day percentage summarizing gait stability, normalized to UCUM percent over the exact aggregation Period. As a windowed aggregate it is implemented by the phase-2 aggregate design rather than as a point measurement.

code.definition: A windowed percentage score summarizing the stability of the subject's gait over the aggregation period.

measurements.title: Walking Steadiness Notification
measurements.description: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierAppleWalkingSteadinessEvent: raised when the walking steadiness classification is low or very low, distinguishing a first occurrence from a repeat. The walking steadiness percentage remains the measurement surface.

code.definition: A device notification that walking steadiness reached a low or very low classification.

components.title: Notification occurrence
components.definition: Whether this is the first notification at the classification or a repeat.

measurements.title: Walking Step Length
measurements.description: The average length of a single step during ordinary walking, recorded passively by HealthKit and normalized to UCUM centimetres.

code.definition: The distance covered by a single step during ordinary walking, as sampled by the source.

measurements.title: Water Temperature
measurements.description: A HealthKit-exclusive environmental measurement of the water temperature surrounding the wearer during a water activity, normalized to UCUM degrees Celsius. It is an environmental context reading, not a body measurement, and is never mapped to any body-temperature concept.

code.definition: The temperature of the water surrounding the wearer during a water activity, as sampled by the device.

measurements.title: Wheelchair Push Count
measurements.description: The number of wheelchair pushes recorded during an exact effective Period, using LOINC Number of wheelchair pushes per time period and normalized to the UCUM annotation {pushes}. It is the wheelchair analogue of step-count and never substitutes for it.

code.display: Number of wheelchair pushes per time period

measurements.title: Grove HealthKit Wheelchair Use
measurements.description: Wheelchair-use status as a coded Observation. No context-free ACTIVE LOINC exists: 89411-3 'Does the patient use a wheelchair/scooter' is Deprecated, and its ACTIVE successor 95738-1 'Does the patient use a wheelchair/scooter during assessment period [CMS Assessment]' is bound to a CMS assessment-period context and method, which the HealthKit characteristic does not carry — adopting it would fabricate an assessment context. Observation.code is therefore Grove-coded. The status materially changes interpretation of HK distanceWheelchair and pushCount data, which is why platform-exclusive support is defensible rather than intentionally-unsupported.

code.definition: Whether the subject uses a wheelchair, as recorded in the HealthKit wheelchair-use characteristic.

resultCodes.definition: The subject does not use a wheelchair.

measurements.title: Workout
measurements.description: One recorded workout session: the shared activity classification as the result, the exact session bounds as the effective Period, and optional per-session statistics as components. The exact platform activity token is retained as a secondary coding; segments and laps are linked child Observations, so no session information is dropped.

code.definition: One recorded workout session over the exact Observation effective Period.

measurements.title: Workout Effort Score
measurements.description: Apple's 1-10 workout effort rating over the associated workout's exact effective Period, covering both the user-entered WorkoutEffortScore and the system-computed EstimatedWorkoutEffortScore; the rating method (user-entered versus estimated) is a required adapter distinction. The value is normalized to the UCUM annotation {score}.

code.definition: An Apple-proprietary 1-10 rating of perceived or estimated workout effort for the exact associated workout Period.

measurements.title: Workout Segment
measurements.description: One segment, lap, pause, marker, or event within a workout session, linked from the parent workout through hasMember. The value is the segment classification — an activity code or a structural code — with the exact platform token retained; per-segment statistics ride the open component slicing.

code.definition: One classified interval or event within a workout session.
